scope: Full Japanese premises, 11 turns and 5 hints per scenario checked against all 12 locale targets in conversation context.
reviewCriteria: Meaning in the complete premise and dialogue

changes.sourceJa: 頼まれた額はありますが、私が立て替えた分も足すか迷っています。
changes.before: There is an amount I was asked to send, but I am unsure whether to add what I paid in advance.
changes.after: There is an amount I was asked to send, but I am unsure whether to add the money I paid on their behalf.

changes.sourceJa: 依頼額への立替分追加を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
changes.before: Discuss adding the amount you paid in advance to the requested amount. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Discuss whether to add the money you paid on their behalf to the requested amount. Say it in Japanese.

changes.sourceJa: では、立替分を別にメモして、合計してよいか友人へ聞きます。
changes.before: Then I will note the amount I paid in advance separately and ask my friend whether I may add it to the total.
changes.after: Then I will note the amount I paid on their behalf separately and ask my friend whether I may add it to the total.

changes.sourceJa: 立替額を別記して相手へ照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
changes.before: Record the advance payment separately and ask the other person. Say it in Japanese.
changes.after: Note the amount you paid on their behalf separately and ask them about it. Say it in Japanese.

changes.sourceJa: はい。返事を待ちます。依頼額と立替額を二行に分けて送ります。
changes.before: That's right. I will wait for a reply. I will send the requested amount and the advance payment on two separate lines.
changes.after: That's right. I will wait for a reply. I will send the requested amount and the amount I paid on their behalf on two separate lines.

changes.sourceJa: 別の傷は分けてください。
changes.after: Please set aside the photo of the other injury.

changes.sourceJa: 手紙を入れて閉じました。入れ直した状態で重さを量ってください。
changes.before: Tôi đã cho thư vào và đóng lại rồi. Xin cân hộp trong tình trạng đã cho thư vào lại này.
changes.after: Tôi đã cho thư vào và đóng hộp lại rồi. Xin cân hộp khi đã có cả thư bên trong.

changes.sourceJa: 別の傷は分けてください。
changes.after: Pakihiwalay po ang litrato ng ibang sugat.

changes.sourceJa: 余りは別の料理に使います。小袋よりこちらを二袋にします。
changes.before: Gagamitin ko ang sobra sa ibang lutuin. Dalawa nitong supot ang kukunin ko sa halip na maliliit.
changes.after: Gagamitin ko ang sobra sa ibang lutuin. Dalawang supot nito ang kukunin ko sa halip na maliliit.

changes.sourceJa: この施設です。ただ、地図が古くて、自分で引いた矢印もあります。
changes.before: इस सुविधा में। मगर नक्शा पुराना है और इसमें मेरे खुद बनाए तीर भी हैं।
changes.after: इस जगह जाना है। मगर नक्शा पुराना है और इसमें मेरे खुद बनाए तीर भी हैं।

changes.sourceJa: その前に、部品の使い方を書いた手紙を入れ忘れたことに気付きました。
changes.before: उससे पहले ध्यान आया कि पुर्ज़ों के इस्तेमाल का तरीका लिखी चिट्ठी अंदर डालना भूल गया।
changes.after: उससे पहले ध्यान आया कि पुर्ज़ों के इस्तेमाल का तरीका बताने वाली चिट्ठी अंदर डालना भूल गया।

changes.sourceJa: 別の傷は分けてください。
changes.before: တခြားဒဏ်ရာကို ခွဲထားပေးပါ။
changes.after: တခြားဒဏ်ရာရဲ့ ဓာတ်ပုံကို ခွဲထားပေးပါ။

changes.sourceJa: 別の傷は分けてください。
